temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days during a busy, stressful week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is normally engaging, so her recent quietness is unusual; Carolyn does not yet know why Marilyn is withdrawn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed from uncertainty to a clearer understanding that Marilyn is dealing with work and personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed and may need support, though she has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and keep communication open for Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn was curt in a later interaction. When Carolyn apologizes if she overstepped and shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed and may have appreciated her concern, but the later curt response leaves her unsure whether she overstepped or caused offense.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed from confusion and hurt to relief and understanding: Marilyn's curtness was likely due to her own hard week, not necessarily to Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is having a difficult time, but Carolyn's support is welcomed and any misunderstanding is eased.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear the air and show support without overstepping.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and accepts the invitation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their clarifying conversation, Carolyn believes Marilyn appreciates her openness and that their friendship may be developing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and strengthened: Marilyn is receptive to social connection and wants to join the gathering.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their friendship is strengthening, and Marilyn is interested in spending time outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the gathering and strengthen the friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn directly raises the work dynamic, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the positive outside interactions and accepted invitation, Carolyn believes their friendship is warming and that Marilyn is generally friendly toward her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed from assuming growing closeness to noticing a work-specific distance; then revised after Marilyn's response suggests the distance may be unintentional and she is open to improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is a workplace distance to address, but Marilyn is willing to discuss it and improve their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address their work dynamic and improve collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Marilyn agrees to team up for the new project proposal, says she is glad they had the talk, and says she is looking forward to working more closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and strengthened: Marilyn shares Carolyn's optimism and is willing to collaborate closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They understand each other better and can pursue a positive working partnership.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
